analysis.release_cancel_rules: Delayed ultimate cannot be interrupted

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Line projectile and timed target charge
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Sustained storm channel
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Storm needs line of sight; show its growing edge

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Scoped shot gains damage with charge; cancel unspecified
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Cover and flight exposure; distinguish charge from ready

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Health spending, tether, close health swap
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Drain permits firing/other abilities
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Break drain line/range; clearly show health cost

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Contact-dependent charge payoff
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Avoid wall pin; separate startup from impact

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Weapon builds cards; crosshair directs throws
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Card alternate cast; targeted slam
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Track teleport endpoint and card availability

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Place turret, healer, wall; aim barrage
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Attack/Ability3 erupts wall early
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Wall is melee destructible; show placement/active phases

analysis.movement: Charge increases speed; aerial aim changes time
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Carbine charge plus projectile swap
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Missed line costs setup; wall must read as projectile modifier

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Ground pulse; nearby heal and pull
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Dash/melee preserve heal channel; ally alternate teleport
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Spread before pull; telegraph channel/radius

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Beam slows caster; route uses existing movement inputs
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Both teams use ice; dome boundary must be unambiguous

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Attacking ends stealth; dagger preserves it
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Nearby enemies detect stealth; distinguish sleep from stun

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Attack/shot/melee detonates barrel; pad extends lasso
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Shared pad and explosive prop need ownership clarity

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Delayed bomb; sustained beam
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Avoid hook line; allies can be moved too

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Damage resets cat speed; shadow returns after delay
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Track reappearance timing; keep form silhouette legible

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Hold Attack/Ability1; Mantle ends glide/owl control
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Dodge shot; trap has arm phase and early shot detonation

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Channel holds target; damage reduces burrow speed
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Keep distance; read underground/exit phases

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Execute recast window; active clears deferred damage
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Execution threshold and stored damage need separate cues

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Thorn patch, ally link, carry target
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Link needs line of sight; damage briefly blocks flight start
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Carry constrains ally attacks; link/radius must stay readable

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Enemy gets escape interval; ultimate charges first
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Leave marked origin before root; show deadline and boundary

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Attack/Ability1 releases weaker slash early
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Charge exposure creates opening; show partial/full readiness

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Ground strike scales with height; multi-target latch
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Attack slams early; latch drops out-of-range/occluded targets
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Break latch line/range; show connected targets

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Goo placement, cube protection, melee punch
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Mantle exits cube; cube prevents new actions
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Punch can be parried; cube must show protection/lockout

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Recast cloak teleports; any action ends suitcase; dash/cloak preserve barrage
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Track cloak endpoint and return burst; affliction non-lethal

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Activate consumes marks; damage interrupts teleport wait
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Attack during travel windup; mark count/arrival cue

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Stacking daggers; delayed venom; direct-hit bola
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Venom delayed; petrify prevents actions and blocks damage
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Differentiate splash slow from direct petrify

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Redirect bolt; duplicate aim; hex area; copied ultimate
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Recast bolt redirects, assistant swaps, ultimate uses copied action
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Clone ownership and currently copied power dominate reading load

analysis.movement: Untargetable retreat with short recast window
analysis.aim_and_complexity: Per-target bite buildup; seeking bat ultimate
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Retreat can recast; Rake base description absent
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Show bite cooldown per target and retreat destination

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Close cone, bleeding mark, isolation detection
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Recast mark only during bleed; vision-limiting ultimate
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Stay grouped; mark expiry and darkness boundary need cues

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Trap arms; final stake receives distinct payoff
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Avoid wall pin and trap; count remaining empowered stakes

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Damage intake charges battery; growing aura
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Aura also hurts self; lethal event triggers reanimation channel
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Leave reanimation area; distinguish health and battery

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Directed dragon, ally barrier, delayed root
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Area detonates after delay; wave strength grows with travel
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Exit marked zone; barrier and moving wave need separate forms

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Shootable bell; cart path; target exile
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Bell shoots early; portal pair placement constrained
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Read both portal ends; exile has return/deadline rule

analysis.movement: Rising charge and descending bat slam
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Chain yanks after delay; line-of-sight loss breaks it
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Break sight and avoid grouped chain; distinct taut/slack states

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Jar summons follow weapon target; line snare; grave
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Jar resource fills from deaths; grave spawns over time
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Grave destroyed by two heavy melees; identify summon owner

analysis.movement: Back leap, riposte dash, directional lunges
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Perfect release window; recast lunges; hold ultimate delays
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Bait deflection; show release window without hiding opponents

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Dive early; empty landing stuns self; jetpack cools after heat
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Predict forced landing; show heat, fuel, mark distinctly

analysis.release_cancel_rules: One heal per ally; ultimate stun detaches; gaze ends in sleep
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Watch attachment and channel direction; distinguish helper tasks

analysis.movement: Kick approaches then pushes self away
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Bloodlust auto-transforms or active transforms; replaces kit
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Transformation changes threat; mark/bloodlust visible

analysis.aim_and_complexity: Cone mark; delayed beam; bouncing orb
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Barrier destruction triggers silence/burst; beam forms after delay
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Leave beam marker; avoid feeding prism burst nearby

analysis.release_cancel_rules: Grenade can be meleed; dash shakes off rats
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Dash/melee are direct answers; rat count and banner radius visible

analysis.movement: Moves allied/self pieces with existing aim input
analysis.aim_and_complexity: Persistent bishop, knight, split rooks, relocating queen
analysis.release_cancel_rules: Recast recalls bishop/queen or splits rooks; ADS moves pieces
analysis.counterplay_and_readability_inference: Track ownership and active piece; show affected squares
